properties.name: 2_configs build pipeline
properties.description: The source-of-truth compiler. Two stages: consolidate (merge all build.json/config.json via typed parsers) → derive (emit every per-consumer artifact). SOLE emitter — every service symlink resolves into 2_configs/dist/.

properties.name: cloud-data-config-consolidated.ts
properties.description: Stage 1: merges a_solutions/*/build.json + config.json + b_infra + vault WG pubkeys → _cloud-data-consolidated.json. WG public keys: vault/A0_keys/providers/wireguard/<name>/publickey is the SoT (config.json values are a removed stale fallback).

properties.name: cloud-data-config-derive.ts (+derivers.json)
properties.description: Stage 2: emits build-{service}.json, build-caddy.json, Authelia ACL, DNS, kg-graph schema+delta, mesh-snapshot, build-workflows, external-consumers slices, code-signatures. Ordered registry in derivers.json (append-only, data-driven).

properties.name: 2_configs parsers
properties.description: Typed source parsers feeding the consolidator: build-json, compose, caddyfile, authelia, dns, wireguard, terraform, cloudflare, ntfy, mailu.

properties.name: derive-code-signatures.ts
properties.description: Deterministic per-file signature extractor (exports/imports/symbols) for any repo → code-signatures-<repo>.json. Feeds the kg-graph code layer + the Opus semantic pass.

properties.name: 1_workflows ship engine
properties.description: Universal deploy: build(nix)→secrets(sops→dist/.secrets)→deploy(rsync)→compose(up -d --no-build). Builds on a RUNNER (oci-apps ARM via build-workflows.json, or GHA) → GHCR; VMs only pull. Steps: build-nix/docker/compose, secrets-decrypt, deploy-rsync/compose/health, lifecycle, terraform, wrangler.

properties.name: home-manager ship
properties.description: Delivers per-VM HM as a GHCR image (1GB VMs OOM on nix-eval): build flake→push→VM pull+activate. Carries vm-pilot onto every VM.

properties.name: vm-pilot protection
properties.description: Per-VM resilience: scheduler.slice (SSH/WG CPUWeight=10000, OOM-immune) + docker.slice cap; resource-bouncer (earlyoom + docker MemoryMax); load-shedder (stop docker on memory PSI → keep WG alive, never freeze); rescue-ssh dropbear (WG-bound); no-build-guardrails HARD-BLOCK build on <2GB.

properties.name: Caddy edge (routing SoT)
properties.description: Caddy :443 = HTTP reverse_proxy + L4 SNI mux (incl. mail IMAPS/SMTPS), the single routing source of truth, derived into build-caddy.json. Public edge on oci-analytics; gcp-proxy is WG-only hub.

properties.name: bb-sec_caddy
properties.description: Reverse proxy + L4 mux; caddyfile.nix consumes build-caddy.json. wg_only fail-closed default; remote_ip gate for mcp/private.

properties.name: bb-sec_authelia
properties.description: 2FA (TOTP/WebAuthn) + OIDC. client_secret = pbkdf2-sha512 digest. SMTP via Maddy. ACL derived into the kg-graph authenticated_by edges.

properties.name: bb-sec_introspect-proxy
properties.description: OIDC introspection sidecar — validates bearer tokens for CLI/API access behind Caddy.

properties.name: WireGuard mesh
properties.description: 10.0.0.0/24 connects all VMs; gcp-proxy hub. wg-public for operator devices; wstunnel TCP/443 fallback. SSH is WG-only (ssh-firewall enforces). Pubkeys from vault SoT.

properties.name: C3 control plane (API+MCP)
properties.description: c3-infra-api/mcp (SSH/Docker/build/Dagu control; ops.ts triggerDag → DAGU_API/api/v1), c3-services-api/mcp (consolidated service REST/MCP registry), c3-public-api (single public edge), c3-analytics-api. shared/ independent (not symlinked).

properties.name: bc-obs_cloud-cgc-mcp
properties.description: Code Graph Context MCP. a-knowledge (reads consolidated: topology/configs/specs/skills); octocode (FastEmbed semantic search + GraphRAG over /repos, volumes octocode_db/repos, GIT_ROOT=/repos); codegraph (THIS unified kg-graph: infra+code+semantic, bundled at /app/code/graphs).

properties.name: ca-dat_kg-graph
properties.description: SurrealDB hybrid KG (graph+vector). Schema+delta derived from consolidated (vm/service/container/domain/repo/module/package + edges). enabled:false (planning). Hosts the graph-semantic-<repo>.json layer.

properties.name: bc-obs_dagu
properties.description: DAG scheduler (moved oci-analytics→oci-apps to stop freezing the 1GB VM). ops_octocode-reindex: fresh-clone repos→octocode clear+index→restart cgc. API /api/v1.

properties.name: mail stack (oci-mail)
properties.description: Maddy (SMTP/IMAP) + Stalwart (JMAP) + mail-puller + cypht/snappymail webmail. Clients connect on :443 via Caddy L4 SNI (imap./smtps./jmap.). MX :25 via CF Worker bridge.

properties.name: data + collab services (oci-apps)
properties.description: gitea, vaultwarden, photoprism, grist, hedgedoc, etherpad, filebrowser, radicale (cal/contacts), matrix-continuwuity+element, mattermost, code-server, dbgate, nocodb, ntfy.

properties.name: fin + AI services
properties.description: crawlee-cloud (scraping), fin-api, news-gdelt; ollama-arm/hai + rig-agentic (LLM agents). paca (multi-container app).

properties.name: observability
properties.description: matomo + umami (analytics), openobserve (logs/traces), health reports (1_reports Rust crates probing the mesh), ntfy alerts.

properties.name: _cloud-data-consolidated.json
properties.description: Master superset (vms/services/configs/dns/deps/wireguard). Read by every consumer.

properties.name: build-caddy.json
properties.description: Aggregated Caddy routes.

properties.name: build-kg-graph_delta.json
properties.description: Deterministic kg-graph nodes/edges (infra+code-structure).

properties.name: code-signatures-<repo>.json ×6
properties.description: Per-repo file/export/import structure.

properties.name: octocode FastEmbed+GraphRAG index
properties.description: volume octocode_db @ /home/appuser/.local/share/octocode, /repos-keyed. DAG-built, cgc-queried.

properties.name: build-workflows.json
properties.description: .runners[arch].host — routes builds to oci-apps(arm64)/GHA(amd64).

properties.rationale: build on a runner, never on the small target VM
load-shedder + connectivity.slice keep WG alive under pressure
